author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಯೌವನದಿ ಸರಿತಪ್ಪು ಗೊಂದಲವು ಸಹಜವಹು
ಸಾವರಿಸಿ ಉತ್ತರವ ಹುಡುಕುತಿರಬೇಕು
ಹೂವಂತೆ ಅರಳುತಿರೆ ಕಣ್ಮುಂದೆ ಸತ್ಯಗಳು
ಜೀವನವೆ ಸೊಬಗಿನದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: In youth, confusion over right and wrong is natural;
gather yourself and keep seeking answers;
when truths open like flowers before your eyes,
life itself becomes graceful, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Young people naturally struggle with right and wrong. Keep searching patiently; as truth unfolds, life grows beautiful.
